svg.title: Sampling aliases measured in the synthetic Signal Atlas experiment
svg.desc: Separate Fourier spectra show a 17 Hz tone apparently at 3 Hz for a 20 Hz sample clock, then at 17 Hz for a 100 Hz sample clock.
